sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Sajeet Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.587 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 302 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nanpara, District Bahraich.
3. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased.

It is further argued that the co-accused, mother-in-law on similar allegations has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 23.02.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.620 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.620 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Jagdish Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the allegations to be similar to that of the co-accused; the applicant is the father-in-law coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 28.09.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Jagdish Soni be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 akverma  Jagdish Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...
